svg.title: custom-pdm enclosure wiring block diagram, sheet 1 of 3
svg.text: PDM enclosure, plan view, lid off (not to scale). Blocks sit where the parts sit in the box; line paths are logical, not the wire routes.
front wall (south): X1, X2 and the USB-C bulkhead go through it
GND: chassis ground, M6 copper boss through the lid + copper bar across the three boards (copper, not in the wire list)
BATT+: +12 V battery feed 150 A, M6 copper boss through the lid + copper bar across the three boards (copper, not in the wire list)
T1-T4: OUT1-4, 31 A each, M4 copper risers
through the lid (copper, not in the wire list)
USB-C in: VBUS D+ D- GND CC

svg.text: custom-pdm enclosure harness: wiring block diagram
GENERATED 2026-11-21 by harness/src/enclosure_harness.py diagram. Do not edit: change the CSV files and rebuild.
111 wires in 26 lines, 32 connectors / ends. Sources (sha256, line ends read as LF):
Block places: enclosure/v2c/src/build_v2c.py rev D (branch chore/cad-models-fusion). 11 x 17 in.
One line = the wires that run together between two blocks. The tick number = how many wires. Label = line ID, wire IDs, count x gauge, colours.
The pin lists in the two end boxes of a line are in the same order (wire ID order): first pin to first pin. Grey text = the signals.
Sheets 2-3 list every wire pin to pin with its line ID. Line weight: thick 12-16 AWG, medium 20 AWG, thin 28 AWG / USB cores. TPn = twisted pair n.
Grey dashed = copper (bosses, bars, risers), not wires and not in the wire list.
X1 spare cavities (sealing plug): F T. X2 spare cavities (sealing plug): 1 4 5 6 34 39 40 41 42 43 44 45 46 47.
